# ReadMe

Developer hubs hosted by ReadMe (`*.readme.io` or a custom domain): guides, API reference, recipes, custom pages and changelog.

## Detect

- Rendered HTML loads images from `files.readme.io`.
- URLs use `/docs/<slug>`, `/reference/<slug>`, `/recipes/<slug>`, `/page/<slug>` and `/changelog/<slug>`, optionally behind a version or project segment (`/main/docs/...`, `/v2.0/docs/...`).
- Page markdown contains emoji callouts (`> 📘`), `[block:...]` blocks, `<<variable>>` or `(doc:slug)` links.
- In a repo: top-level `docs/`, `reference/`, `recipes/`, `custom_pages/`, `custom_blocks/`, `changelogs/` and `_order.yaml` files.

## Get the source

Mintlify's guide for this platform: https://www.mintlify.com/docs/migration/readme.md

### From the repo

A Git sync repo (bi-directional sync): one repo per project, one branch per ReadMe version. https://docs.readme.com/main/docs/bi-directional-sync. Layout: https://docs.readme.com/main/docs/documentation-structure

- A page with children is a folder with `index.md`, the children, and `_order.yaml`.
- `_order.yaml` is a flat list of child slugs (no extension, never `index`) in sidebar order.
- `reference/` holds the OpenAPI files and endpoint pages; endpoint frontmatter `api.file` + `api.operationId` ties a page to an operation.

### From an export

Either of these, run by the customer per version, with the same layout as the repo:

- ZIP export from the Branch menu, emailed to the customer. It includes OpenAPI files but not images. https://docs.readme.com/main/docs/exporting-data
- `rdme docs export <folder>` (and `rdme reference export`) with their own API key. https://github.com/readmeio/rdme

Export every maintained version. Hidden and unpublished pages are only in the repo or an export.

### From the live site

`<page-url>.md` returns markdown; `llms.txt` at the site root and per project lists pages. Quirks (`mint migrate --topic discovery`, Mirror the raw source):

- Strip the generated frontmatter block (`updatedAt`, `agentTools`) at the top and the `# Sibling pages` / `# What's Next` sections at the end.
- Reference `.md` pages embed the operation's spec under a `# OpenAPI definition` JSON block. Extract it as data; it is not page content.
- The changelog index `.md` is a link list, not an entry.

## Config → docs.json

| ReadMe                                               | docs.json                                           |
| ---------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------- |
| Project name                                         | `name`                                              |
| Logo (light/dark), favicon                           | `logo.light`, `logo.dark`, `favicon`                |
| Brand / theme colors                                 | `colors.primary`                                    |
| Top navigation sections (Guides, API Reference, ...) | `navigation.tabs`                                   |
| Header links                                         | `navbar.links`                                      |
| Versions                                             | `navigation.versions` if the customer migrates them |
| Glossary                                             | drop; terms become `<Tooltip>` at use sites         |
| Custom CSS / JS, custom HTML header/footer           | drop and report                                     |
| Personalized docs, JWT login, API key injection      | drop and report                                     |
| Metrics, Owlbot AI, suggested edits, discussions     | drop and report                                     |

## Navigation

- One tab per hub section the source shows (Guides, Recipes, API Reference, Changelog, custom pages).
- `docs/` category folders become groups in folder order; inside each folder, `_order.yaml` sets page order.
- A folder's `index.md` is the first page of its nested group.
- From the live site, rebuild the tree from each section's rendered sidebar.
- Frontmatter `hidden: true` pages stay reachable but out of navigation; (`mint migrate --topic navigation`, Structure rules).
- Link pages (frontmatter `link.url`) become navigation links.

## Content conversion

| ReadMe                                                 | Mintlify                                                                                |
| ------------------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Blockquote starting `📘` or `ℹ️`                       | `<Info>`                                                                                |
| `👍` or `✅`                                           | `<Check>`                                                                               |
| `🚧` or `⚠️`                                           | `<Warning>`                                                                             |
| `❗️` or `🛑`                                           | `<Danger>`                                                                              |
| Callout title (text after the emoji on the first line) | bold first line (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Components)                         |
| `<Callout icon theme>`                                 | callout by `theme`, as above                                                            |
| Consecutive fences with no blank line between them     | `<CodeGroup>`; the text after the language is the tab title                             |
| `<Tabs>`, `<Accordion>`, `<Cards>`, `<Columns>`        | `<Tabs>`, `<Accordion>`, `<CardGroup>`, `<Columns>`                                     |
| `[title](url "@embed")`, `<Embed>`                     | video embed if supported, else a link                                                   |
| `[block:callout]`                                      | callout by its theme                                                                    |
| `[block:code]`                                         | fences, or `<CodeGroup>` for several                                                    |
| `[block:image]`                                        | image in `<Frame caption>`                                                              |
| `[block:parameters]` / `[block:table]`                 | markdown table built from the `data` keys                                               |
| `[block:api-header]`                                   | heading                                                                                 |
| `[block:html]`                                         | the HTML, made MDX-safe                                                                 |
| `[block:embed]`                                        | as `@embed`                                                                             |
| `<<glossary:term>>`, `<Glossary>term</Glossary>`       | `<Tooltip tip="<definition from the glossary>">term</Tooltip>`                          |
| `<<name>>`, `{user.name}` (user variables)             | the variable's default value if the customer wants it inline, else `` `name` ``; report |
| `(doc:slug)`, `(ref:slug)` links                       | root-absolute path of the migrated page                                                 |
| Reusable content / custom blocks (`custom_blocks/`)    | snippet (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Reusable content)                           |
| Custom MDX components                                  | static rendering; report                                                                |

Legacy `[block:TYPE]` blocks wrap JSON terminated by `[/block]`; parse the JSON, do not regex the body. Other link schemes of the form `(<word>:slug)` may exist; count them (`mint migrate --topic conversion`).

Frontmatter: `excerpt` is the subtitle shown under the title, so it maps to `description`. `deprecated: true` maps to `deprecated: true`. `metadata.robots` containing `noindex` maps to `noindex: true`. `next.pages` is the "What's Next" list; keep it as links at the end of the page. Drop `metadata.image` and report it.

**API reference.** Endpoint pages are hand-written prose around a spec. Collect the spec files from `reference/` (or merge the per-page `# OpenAPI definition` fragments), then attach each operation to its migrated page with `openapi:` frontmatter at the page's original path. Do not also add a generated API tab for the same spec. See `mint migrate --topic api`.

**Recipes.** Interactive step-through code walkthroughs. Migrate as a page with `<Steps>` around the steps and the full code in a fence; report the lost interactivity.

**Changelog.** One `<Update>` page per `mint migrate --topic changelog`. Dates: in a Git export, frontmatter `date`; on the live site, `"created_at"` in the JSON embedded in each entry's HTML page. Tags: the entry `type` (Added, Fixed, Improved, Deprecated, Removed) as shown on the source.

## Assets

The ZIP export and Git repo reference images by `https://files.readme.io/...` URL without the files (`mint migrate --topic conversion`, Images and files). Look in page bodies, `[block:image]` JSON and custom pages; images used only in custom pages may need the rendered page to find.

## URLs and redirects

- Keep `/docs/<slug>`, `/reference/<slug>`, `/recipes/<slug>`, `/page/<slug>` paths. ReadMe slugs are flat, so nested navigation does not mean nested URLs; keep the flat path.
- Guides and reference pages can share a slug; the section prefix keeps them distinct.
- Default-version URLs omit the version segment; versioned URLs include it. Redirect the versioned form to whichever path you keep.
- Every `/changelog/<slug>` redirects to the consolidated changelog page.

## Known gaps

- Try It API explorer state, personalized API keys and per-user variables.
- Recipe step-through interactivity.
- Custom pages written in HTML with page-level CSS.
- Owlbot, metrics, suggested edits and discussion threads.
- Hidden or beta versions the customer did not export.
